name: review-pack
title: Manual review assignment
for_each: select id,code from publications order by code

sections.title: Manual
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,language,due_on from publications where id=$1

sections.title: Review assignments
sections.sql: select pt.position,t.code,t.title,t.owner,t.revision,t.approved_by,t.review_due from publication_topics pt join topics t on t.id=pt.topic_id where pt.publication_id=$1 order by pt.position
sections.note: Review the exact revision. A later content change clears approval.

name: release-register
title: Manual release register
for_each: select id,code from publications order by code

sections.title: Retained versions
sections.sql: select version,actor,created_at from releases where publication_id=$1 order by created_at
sections.note: Each retained version contains an immutable content snapshot. No external publication occurs.

sections.title: Current assembly
sections.sql: select pt.position,t.code,t.title,t.revision,t.approved_revision,t.review_due from publication_topics pt join topics t on t.id=pt.topic_id where pt.publication_id=$1 order by pt.position
